personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK (Custom Emerald & Obsidian Luxe Theme)
personality_one_liner: An offline, cinematic personal finance sanctuary styled in obsidian and emerald, designed for mindful tracking, deep analytics, and complete local privacy.

spacing.rule: Generous obsidian padding with glassmorphic cards and clean layout hierarchy.

do's: Use translucent glass cards over obsidian background with subtle emerald glow
Apply glass blur to bottom tab bar and sticky headers
dont's: Avoid blur on form text inputs
Do not use glass without solid dark tint fallback

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of total balance, recent transactions with keyword auto-classification, global wallpaper background, and quick stats.

states.loading: Centered glowing emerald spinner over obsidian
states.empty: Glass card with illustration, prompt to record first transaction
states.error: Banner with readable offline message and retry action

screens.layout: Global wallpaper background with dark glass overlay. Top custom greeting + profile avatar tappable to profile settings. Main balance card with emerald accent, quick action pills, 7/30/60/90 day activity toggle, and recent transactions feed with auto-categorized badges.

screens.name: Transactions & Analytics
screens.purpose: Detailed income/expense logs with 7/30/60/90 day toggles, 6/12 month historical review, PDF/Excel export, and bar/pie category breakdowns.

states.empty: No transactions in this period state with add button
states.error: Failed to read local AsyncStorage data error state

screens.layout: Tabbed analytics view: Bar and Pie charts for category percentage breakdowns (Gaji, Makanan, Transportasi, etc.), range filter pills (7d, 30d, 60d, 90d, 6m, 12m), and export actions for PDF and Excel.

screens.name: Financial Score & Achievements
screens.purpose: Financial health percentage meter (boros or hemat indicator) and habit achievements like 100% score target over 3 or 12 months.

states.empty: No financial history yet for score calculation

screens.layout: Circular gauge representing financial health percentage with badges (Hemat / Boros), followed by gamified achievement cards for savings consistency and long-term milestones.

screens.name: Profile & Settings
screens.purpose: Customize name, avatar, gallery photo, global wallpaper selection, and app preferences.
screens.layout: Scrollable form with editable display name, avatar selector (preset icons, gallery upload), wallpaper picker for global background, and local data export/reset options.

screens.name: Dukung Pembuat (Support Creator)
screens.purpose: Dedicated donation page for creator support with offline QR code placeholder awaiting user asset.

states.empty: QR code placeholder awaiting user asset
states.error: Unable to load offline QR placeholder

screens.layout: Centered luxury glass card featuring appreciation message, offline QR code container with instructions to replace with user QR file, and copy wallet / support info.

wallpaper_default.alt: Dark obsidian abstract green wallpaper background

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure 100% offline local persistence via AsyncStorage. Implement keyword auto-classification for expense categories (e.g. membership game -> Hiburan & Lifestyle) with manual override. Provide PDF and Excel export triggers. Support 7/30/60/90 day activity toggles and 6/12 month historical review. Implement global wallpaper backgrounds on all screens with obsidian/emerald glass styling. Add financial score meter (Hemat vs Boros) and gamified achievements. Add dedicated Dukung Pembuat donation page with offline QR placeholder. No blue/purple banned colors allowed; stick strictly to obsidian and emerald palette.
